text:
Predicates:
InternationalStudent(x) ::: x is an international student in the US.
HasVisaF1(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
HasVisaJ1(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
NeedsToApplyCPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for CPT.
NeedsToApplyOPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for OPT.
WantsToWork(x) ::: x wants to work in the US.
Mike ::: specific individual named Mike.

Premises:
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) → (HasVisaF1(x) ∨ HasVisaJ1(x))) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x ((HasVisaF1(x) ∧ WantsToWork(x)) → (NeedsToApplyCPT(x) ∨ NeedsToApplyOPT(x))) ::: An international student with an F1 visa who wants to work needs to apply for CPT or OPT.
InternationalStudent(Mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
WantsToWork(Mike) ::: Mike wants to work in the US.
NeedsToApplyCPT(Mike) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.

Conclusion:
HasVisaF1(Mike) ::: Mike has an F1 visa.
